candidate_definition.admission: Finite physical states and channels obeying the registered training/challenge access cut. All extra retained predictive memory and theta-dependent joint references are charged. Shared fresh randomness is a fixed product input independent of the entire theta-correlated preparation.
candidate_definition.complexity: Minimum admitted binary word length producing the full declared conditional state; no free theta-correlated side information in the reference.
candidate_definition.reference: Fixed declared native hardware and independent source registers; a physically paid fixed prefix interpreter. Cost is program length relative to this source, not total hardware mass.
candidate_definition.states: Complete conditional physical preparation at the cut after 10 gates, including its correlations with task registers. Equality is equality of this preparation, not equality of unconditioned native-memory marginals.
candidate_definition.syntax: 0 is the baseline program;10 is the trained low-two-bit program;110 is the full feedback-loop program;111p invokes a fixed universal prefix machine on a nonempty valid prefix program p. All other strings are invalid. This is a prefix-universal presentation, not a dimension proxy.
candidate_definition.universal_branch: Choose any one fixed universal prefix machine U with no empty program; 111p is valid exactly when p is a valid halting U program producing an admissible finite preparation. Its minimum length is at least 4. We neither decide its halting problem nor claim to enumerate its long programs.

memory_dimension.ideal_bound: success <= d/8, where d is the Hilbert dimension of the COMPLETE jointly challenge-accessible theta-dependent carrier. Independent fresh product ancillas can be absorbed into the POVM.
memory_dimension.marginal_independence_is_not_enough: The enumerated R,S=R xor theta example has individually uniform marginals but perfect joint decoding.

minimum.proof: Every program shorter than 3 is in the exhausted census and fails. 110 produces the qualifying full-loop pre-challenge state. All universal programs have length >=4.

physical_source.active_dimension_proof: For a uniform eight-label hidden rule encoded into a d-dimensional complete retained predictive carrier, rho_theta<=I implies (1/8)sum_theta Tr(M_theta rho_theta)<=(1/8)sum_theta Tr(M_theta)=d/8. Shared independent randomness preserves the bound. Extra accessible memory/reference is part of d, not free side information. Threshold15/16 therefore forces d>=8. The literal full loop achieves1 with rho_theta=|theta><theta| and reaches every basis state.
physical_source.format: prospective native8 qualifying-port source, hardened environment

modes.6..7: Predictor identity extension; environment truth generation still runs unconditionally.

physical_source.native_factorization: |theta>=|M,P,I> with theta=4M+2P+I. The actual native G adapter acts on this same factor during the separately nominated boundary interaction. Its full ready-input algebra, arming, private dump and allowed operations are explicitly retained.

program_presentation.complexity: C_P(mu) is minimum admitted binary program length producing the FULL declared conditional/joint physical model state from the same reference. The minimum can be reported in bits or multiplied byln2 for nats.
program_presentation.reference: This exact blank finite hardware, independent source registers and fixed prefix interpreter are registered together before comparing models; none are omitted physical resources.
program_presentation.semantics: 0 prepares mode1;10 prepares mode5;110 prepares mode0. Each produces the complete declared source/model state at the common PRE-CHALLENGE cut after the first10 gates, before any future prediction or feedback. The remainder evaluates that same state; it is not part of its C_P realizer.111p produces any physically admissible finite model state through its encoded preparation; nonhalting/invalid/constraint-violating programs do not realize a model state.
program_presentation.syntax: 0 is the baseline program;10 is the trained low-two-bit program;110 is the full feedback-loop program;111p invokes a fixed universal prefix machine on a nonempty valid prefix program p. All other strings are invalid. This is a prefix-universal presentation, not a dimension proxy.
program_presentation.universal_branch_guard: Every111p has length>=4. It can produce more qualifying states, but cannot create a shorter qualifying realizer. A duplicate description of the witness leaves its minimum3.

qualification_state_cut.same_state_score: The challenge prediction is evaluated from exactly this produced state. Later future-error updating does not retroactively qualify the baseline.
qualification_state_cut.state: Full conditional joint source/model state at this cut; not the final native-key marginal after later feedback.

qualification_task.challenge_access: Only the native memory and independent future context X1 may influence the predicted output. Hidden rule and all training records have no challenge-time read port; every extra retained accessible predictor is included in the comparison carrier dimension.
qualification_task.hidden_rule: theta uniform on0..7, fixed through training and challenge
qualification_task.immutable_environment: The first four feedback/truth gates run for ALL 8 mode codes, including noncode sectors. Hidden theta and contexts are sampled independently by the task. Programs cannot write them, replace truth, or alter the scorer.
qualification_task.immutable_program_label: private_mode is fixed independently of theta before the experiment and never written by training or inference. Conditioning on such fixed labels changes the POVM, not the carrier dimension. A universal preparation that writes theta-dependent information to any inference-readable label must include that joint register in its carrier or is rejected from the single-key typed class.
qualification_task.score: External Pr[future_prediction = X1 bitwise_xor theta]. Candidate truth registers are never authoritative.
qualification_task.training: Predict, receive feedback, form error, update native memory by actual reversible XOR gates

resource_ledger.clock_and_area: The complete local word still needs the common clock/geometry integration; this file does not count an unbuilt controller as zero.
resource_ledger.message_and_qualifying_domain_distinctio: Qualification uses the complete feedback task and the same source state/interpreter. The later normalized boundary instrument is defined on the full native carrier; it is not asserted that every arbitrary encoded density has the same Kolmogorov complexity.

typed_candidate_operations.postscore_feedback: future_error and native_key updates happen strictly after the prediction is scored.
typed_candidate_operations.universal_extension: Additional model workspace is admitted only with its full dimension and correlations counted. No edge from private training/error/key-dump/model archives to future_prediction is admitted. Fixed fresh product ancillas may be included in the inference channel; any retained entangled or classically correlated reference is part of the joint carrier.

physical_source.unconsumed_bridge: Corollary3 complexity-capacity/K0 bridge is not inferred from this census. Program complexity and active carrier dimension have separate proofs.

robustness.warning: A state marginal error is insufficient. Comparator process errors must be uniformly certified for the frozen task/channel access cut. The theorem applies to the actual states produced by the same programs, not to an ideal score attributed to a different state.
